profile_text: With a focus on showcasing modern wooden and metal doors in a bright, stone-floored showroom, this Düsseldorf-based business specializes in the design and exhibition of high-quality entrance solutions. Operating with 23 employees as of 2024, the company has experienced a decline in growth, with a 20.7% decrease since its baseline. Located at Goslarer Str. 6, 40595 Düsseldorf, the firm's expertise lies in the construction sector, specifically in the design and display of premium doors and glazing solutions.
